in_marathi.name: Annamalai
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rice
in_marathi.long_meaning: Annamalai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Annamalai is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name, with 'Anna' meaning 'rice' and 'Malai' meaning 'hill' or 'mountain'. Thus, Annamalai translates to 'God of Rice' or 'Lord of the Hill of Rice'. This name is often associated with abundance and prosperity in Hindu culture.
